This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 09/01/2026 (the "Effective
Date") by and between Distribuciones Ibérica SL, with its registered office at Avenida Diagonal 220,
Valencia ("Party A"), and Suministros del Norte SL, with its registered office at Calle Mayor 15,
Madrid ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 24 months from the Effective Date unless
terminated earlier in accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall
use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by Swedish law.

Signatures

 Party A   Distribuciones Ibérica SL / Lucía Fernández
 Party B   Suministros del Norte SL / Carlos García
 Date      09/01/2026
